class.name: VAInputStreamSource
class.description: A [VAStreamSource] fed automatically by a local input (microphone) capture device, instead of a script manually calling [method VAStreamSource.push_audio_data]. No script is required for the common case: as soon as this node enters a running (non-editor) scene tree, it automatically calls [method VAStreamSource.open_stream], [method open_capture], and [method start_capture] itself, using the [member format]/[member sample_rate]/[member device_name]/[member buffer_size_frames] properties below. Every frame after that, captured audio is automatically pushed into the stream. Call [method open_capture]/[method start_capture] manually instead if a script needs to defer capture, switch devices at runtime, or otherwise not use the automatic startup sequence. See [VANetworkedStreamSource] for the equivalent node type meant to be fed from a network connection instead of a local input device.

members.member: The OpenAL format of the captured PCM data - see [method VAStreamSource.open_stream]'s [param format]. Used for both the automatic [method VAStreamSource.open_stream] call and the automatic [method open_capture] call this node makes on [code]_ready[/code].

The sample rate, in Hz, of the captured PCM data - see [method VAStreamSource.open_stream]'s [param frequency]. Used for both the automatic [method VAStreamSource.open_stream] call and the automatic [method open_capture] call this node makes on [code]_ready[/code]. Shown in the Inspector as a dropdown of common rates (matching [member VAOpenALSettings.sample_rate]), but any positive value can still be set via script.

Which input device to capture from, passed to the automatic [method open_capture] call this node makes on [code]_ready[/code]. Leave empty for the driver's default input device, or use a name returned by [method VAOpenALSettings.get_available_capture_devices]. Shown in the Inspector as a dropdown of the driver's currently available capture devices (matching [member VAOpenALSettings.capture_device_name]'s suggestion-style dropdown - the value is still a plain string, so a device unplugged after being selected here isn't cleared).
The size, in frames, of the capture device's internal ring buffer, passed to the automatic [method open_capture] call this node makes on [code]_ready[/code].

method.name: open_capture
method.description: Opens an input device for capturing. [param device_name] selects which device to open - pass an empty string for the driver's default input device, or a name returned by [method VAOpenALSettings.get_available_capture_devices]. [param format] and [param frequency] should normally match what was passed to [method VAStreamSource.open_stream], since no resampling happens between capture and playback. [param buffer_size_frames] sizes the device's internal ring buffer, in frames. If a capture device is already open, it is closed first. Returns [code]false[/code] if the device could not be opened, e.g. no such device exists, or the current OpenAL device doesn't support capture.

method.name: start_capture
method.description: Starts capturing from the device opened by [method open_capture]. Captured audio is automatically pushed into this node's stream every frame from then on, as long as [method VAStreamSource.open_stream] has also been called. Does nothing (with a logged error) if [method open_capture] hasn't been called yet.

method.name: stop_capture
method.description: Stops capturing from the device opened by [method open_capture], without closing it - [method start_capture] can be called again later to resume. Safe to call even if capture was never started.

method.name: close_capture
method.description: Stops capturing (if active) and closes the input device opened by [method open_capture]. Safe to call even if [method open_capture] was never called or already closed.

method.name: is_capture_open
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [method open_capture] has been called and [method close_capture] hasn't been called since.
